chunks: We did not wrong them; but they wronged themselves. So their gods, whom they called upon besides Allah, were not of any avail when your Lord's command came, nor did they increase them except in destruction.
ai.seo_question: Why were the false gods of the disbelievers useless on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of 'self-inflicted harm' (ẓalamū anfusahum), illustrating that divine punishment is a natural consequence of rejecting truth rather than an arbitrary decree. The phrase 'added them only to ruin' (ghayr tatbīb) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as indicating that idols not only failed to save them but actively exacerbated their destruction, serving as a thematic parallel to the concept of 'fitrah' and the internalization of divine justice.
